exam_price_notes: Check the official booking page for the price in your country or region.
renewal_options: Microsoft certifications (Associate/Expert/Specialty) are renewed annually for free via a short renewal assessment on Microsoft Learn. Renewal assessment available 6 months before expiry. Fundamentals certifications do not expire.
recommended_experience: Familiarity with Azure, Microsoft 365 services and workloads, and Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS). Familiarity with PowerShell and Kusto Query Language (KQL).

retake_policy.notes: After the first failure, wait 24 hours. Wait 14 days between later attempts. At most five attempts in the 12 months starting with the first attempt; after five failures, wait until that period ends. Retake fees apply. See Microsoft's policy for exceptions.

study_actions.title: Atlas study exercise: Review an identity lifecycle
study_actions.detail: Follow a user from joining an organization through a role change and departure. Identify authentication, authorization and access-review decisions at each step. Explain how you would check that access is appropriate, then map the scenario to identity governance objectives. This is a study aid, not an official exam question or a prediction of your result.
